name: Stripe
subtitle: Payments infrastructure
creator: Patrick and John Collison
description: The developer-favorite payments platform: one-off payments, subscriptions, invoices, marketplaces and more through a clean API. Checkout and Payment Links give you a hosted payment page without building forms.

languages.youWrite: Official SDKs for JS, Python, Ruby, PHP, Java, Go and .NET

concepts.explanation: Track a payment through its steps.
Stripe tells your server what happened.
Only the publishable key goes to the browser.

pairsWith.reason: Clerk Billing is built on Stripe

cons: You handle sales tax yourself (unless you add Stripe Tax)
Fees add up with extra products

pricing.summary: No monthly fee. Standard US card rate is 2.9% + 30¢ per successful charge; extra products (Billing, Tax, Radar) add fees.
